buyer_summary: HBCE provides a public R&D evidence surface showing how governed digital-state evidence can be completed, indexed, explained and summarized without claiming certification, pilot readiness or external execution.

surfaces.title: HBCE MATRIX EG-001 T01-T37 Complete v001
HBCE Public Evidence Explainer v001
surfaces.purpose: Plain-language explanation of the evidence registry and MATRIX baseline.

surfaces.title: HBCE Executive Evidence Pack v001
surfaces.purpose: Executive summary of evidence surface, value, boundaries and next steps.

buyer_problem: Digital decisions are often difficult to prove after the fact.
Many systems preserve logs but do not clearly distinguish accepted state, blocked state, invalidated evidence and non-authorized effects.
Regulated and public-sector workflows need evidence that can be read by technical, compliance and executive stakeholders.
hbce_position: HBCE treats evidence boundaries as part of the product surface.
HBCE separates technical evidence from commercial claims.
HBCE publishes explicit non-claims to reduce ambiguity.
HBCE is preparing a path from public R&D baseline to future pilot discussion.
what_hbce_can_show_today: A completed MATRIX EG-001 T01-T37 evidence baseline.
Git tags and GitHub Releases for published evidence baselines.
buyer_value: A concrete starting point for evidence-based AI governance discussion.
A public baseline for decision-proof, auditability and controlled digital-state transition.
A safer pre-pilot conversation because boundaries and non-claims are explicit.
A structure that can later support buyer-specific evidence packs.

recommended_buyer_next_step.title: Evidence Review Session
scope: Review the public HBCE evidence surface.
Map the buyer's regulated workflow or decision process.
Identify which evidence records would be required for a pilot candidate.
Separate technical feasibility, legal review and commercial readiness.
recommended_buyer_next_step.output: Pilot evidence requirements outline, not a pilot launch commitment.
